ecc_crossed_bootstrap.definition: Crossed paired-seed and shared class-stratified image bootstrap for an additive mean metric
ecc_crossed_bootstrap.limitation: Exploratory percentile interval; few seeds give unstable uncertainty; no new training-dataset variation

diagnostics.evaluation_graph: Same correct emotion graph for all four methods, including the wrong-label training control
diagnostics.energy_note: Repeated eigenvalues are summed within each eigenspace; DC is omitted. Error energy and GSEE are related to the optimized objective, not independent validation.
diagnostics.macro_note: Diagnostic arithmetic mean of class-wise ECC; distinct from primary image-weighted ECC; no new inferential tests or class selection

manifest_verbatim.processing: all shards; preserve source splits; reject corrupt and exact encoded-byte duplicates; JPEG resized 192x192

summary.raw_scope: raw source row count not recorded in preparation manifest
summary.prepared_image_transform: all shards; preserve source splits; reject corrupt and exact encoded-byte duplicates; JPEG resized 192x192
summary.classifier_input_pipeline: PIL EXIF transpose RGB; Resize192x192; random crop160/flip0.5 train; center160 val/test
summary.split_rule: Preserve full mirror source splits after encoded-byte deduplication
summary.exclusion_limits: Corrupt images and exact encoded-byte duplicates rejected; re-encoded, pixel-identical and near duplicates remain possible

global_holm_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity across the earlier nine ECC tests plus this follow-up; not a claim that all ten experiments were planned before any outcomes

prior_three_t4_seeds_not_pooled.selection_note: Historical exploratory protocol; alpha0.3 selected on prior full-data validation; not fresh confirmatory seeds
